data.notes_barbara:
Different products; Different customers; Different core workflows

SS&C focuses on investment and financial-services operations. Its specialist institutional workflows differ from employer payroll and HR.
data.notes_matthew: SS&C does fund administration and software for asset managers and banks. There is no payroll or human resources product here.

data.reason: Paylocity sells cloud payroll and HCM software to US mid-sized employers. SS&C sells investment management, fund administration and financial services software and outsourcing to asset managers, banks and insurers. The products differ and so do the buyers. Both earn subscription and service fees, but that is the only similarity.

SS&C has employee benefits administration and payroll integration products and serves financial businesses, overlapping parts of Paylocity's workforce ecosystem and brokerage customer base. Its main investment operations offering is distinct.

P1.1.text: Unify HR, Finance, & IT | HR & Payroll Simplified | Paylocity

P1.2.text: Paylocity unifies HR, Finance, and IT on one HCM platform, so you can stop piecing systems together and start moving forward together.

P1.3.text: The next evolution of work is here to automate manual processes, reduce risk, and help you move faster.

P1.5.text: Power every team with a single software

P1.9.text: Centralize asset management, access control, and service support – empowering IT to enable the business, not just support it.

P1.10.text: A Payroll bundle is any new purchase of Payroll, standalone or bundled with other products.

P1.11.text: “It was everything we needed, all in one place. Paylocity’s solution helped modernize the entire employee experience.”

P1.12.text: “Paylocity helps us automate manual tasks, save time, and improve our decision-making with data and reporting.”

P1.13.text: What connects it all sets us apart

P1.15.text: Automation and insight embedded in daily processes make everyone more efficient.

P1.17.text: Real-time dashboards and guided actions turn data into decisions.

P1.18.text: Automated processes from end to end save time and improve accuracy.

P1.19.text: Dedicated partnership and support you can count on.

P1.20.text: The ultimate platform for today's workforce

P1.22.text: We stand by your side to help you hit your goals. Our ideas are grounded in your real needs — not in guesswork.

P1.23.text: Innovation is at the heart of what we do.

P1.24.text: Clients say we deliver the best service, and we strive to keep every interaction clear, helpful, and human.

P1.26.text: Dive into the latest research from industry leaders, and get the practical insights you need to automate smarter, act on real data, and make better workforce decisions.

P2.3.text: Built for teams who value connection and efficiency

P2.8.text: Employees are at the heart of any business. You need simple, but impactful solution to stay connected to your coworkers and culture.

P2.9.text: For brokers, advisors, consultants, and advocates by any other name, relationships are everything. The right platform helps you deepen client relationships and grow your book
